profile.name: 通用GPIO设备
profile.description: 通过单个 GPIO 引脚连接到单板计算机或控制器的通用外设类别，可对应简单的数字输入/输出元件，如按钮、开关、指示灯或逻辑电平传感器。在实验室、教学和原型开发中常用于基础电子接口测试、状态检测与简单控制。
profile.description_en: A generic class of peripherals connected through a single GPIO pin to a single-board computer or controller. It can represent simple digital input/output components such as buttons, switches, indicator LEDs, or logic-level sensors. In labs, teaching, and prototyping, it is commonly used for basic electronics interfacing, state sensing, and simple control.
